slices.name: Blog CMS (Create + Publish + Render)
slices.description: Complete blog authoring and publishing pipeline: admin Markdown editor with live preview, blog CRUD API (blogAdmin Lambda), DynamoDB storage with slug uniqueness, public blog listing and single post pages on frontend, admin sidebar navigation, prerender script extension for blog SEO. Includes Terraform infrastructure for blog and SEO Lambdas, API Gateway routes, and IAM roles.

slices.name: Image Pipeline (Upload, Process, Serve)
slices.description: Image upload and processing pipeline: presigned S3 upload URLs from blogAdmin Lambda, S3 event-triggered imageProcessor Lambda using sharp for resize/WebP/thumbnails, CloudFront distribution for serving processed images, S3 bucket with OAC.
user_actions: Supports UA1: Image upload and processing for blog posts

slices.name: SEO Settings (Meta Tags + Overrides)
slices.description: SEO override system: seoAdmin Lambda for CRUD of per-page SEO meta (title, description, OG tags), admin settings page listing all pages with edit forms, frontend SEO component checks DynamoDB for overrides.

slices.name: Custom Analytics (Beacon + Dashboard)
slices.description: Lightweight custom analytics: sendBeacon tracking script on public frontend, analytics Lambda for collect (public) and dashboard (JWT), DynamoDB date-partitioned page view storage, admin dashboard with summary cards, line chart (recharts), top pages, and top referrers.

slices.name: GSC Integration + Content Performance
slices.description: Google Search Console integration via service account: gscProxy Lambda fetching keyword rankings and page performance, DynamoDB caching with 6-hour TTL, admin keyword rankings page with queries/pages tables, content performance page combining analytics + GSC data per blog post.

parallel_groups.reason: S-1 (Blog CMS) and S-4 (Custom Analytics) have no shared dependencies. Blog creates content; Analytics tracks page views. They can be built simultaneously. S-1 delivers core user value (publish blog posts); S-4 enables traffic measurement.

S-2 (Image Pipeline) and S-3 (SEO Settings) both depend only on S-1 and are independent of each other. Image processing enhances blog posts; SEO settings apply to all pages. Can run in parallel after S-1 completes.
S-5 (GSC + Content Performance) depends on both S-1 (blog posts list for content mapping) and S-4 (analytics data for combined metrics). Must wait for both to complete.

api-to-dynamodb.name: API -> DynamoDB
api-to-dynamodb.contract: Blog CRUD, Slug Index, SEO Overrides, Analytics Page Views, GSC Cache

s3-event-to-lambda.name: S3 Event -> Image Processor Lambda
s3-event-to-lambda.contract: S3 ObjectCreated on uploads/ prefix triggers imageProcessor

api-to-gsc-external.name: API -> GSC External
api-to-gsc-external.contract: googleapis searchanalytics.query via service account auth

terraform-to-aws.name: Terraform -> AWS Resources
terraform-to-aws.contract: S3 bucket, CloudFront, Lambda functions, IAM, API GW routes, Secrets Manager
